repositoriesWithNullPluginCount.reason: Legacy discovered repository rows that have not had plugin counts backfilled yet; count is reviewed against the generated catalog.

repositoriesWithUntrimmedDescriptions.reason: Existing generated descriptions contain source whitespace that should be cleaned in the ingestion pipeline; count is reviewed against the generated catalog.

caseInsensitiveRepositoryCollisions.reason: Existing catalog contains case-only owner/repo collisions that need canonicalization; count is reviewed against the generated catalog.

statsGapsOverOneAndHalfDays.reason: Existing historical snapshots have known collection gaps; count is reviewed against the generated catalog.

statsDuplicateUtcDays.reason: Existing historical snapshots include multiple samples on the same UTC calendar day.

statsDeclines.reason: Existing historical snapshots include known repository-count declines; count is reviewed against the generated catalog.
